components.name: Copy Line
components.description: One-line install command with square copy button.
components.css: .ds-copy { display: flex; align-items: center; max-width: 560px; background: var(--bg-2, #0c1110); border: 1px solid var(--line-2, #2d3a34); } .ds-copy code { flex: 1; padding: 14px 16px; font-family: var(--font-mono, 'Geist Mono', monospace); font-size: 0.8125rem; color: var(--fg, #e8eee4); } .ds-copy code::before { content: '$ '; color: var(--accent, #b8ff3c); } .ds-copy button { width: 48px; align-self: stretch; border: 0; border-left: 1px solid var(--line-2, #2d3a34); background: none; color: var(--fg-dim, #98a396); cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.15s, background 0.15s; } .ds-copy button:hover { color: var(--accent-ink, #07090a); background: var(--accent, #b8ff3c); } .ds-copy button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #b8ff3c); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-band { background: var(--accent, #b8ff3c); padding: 24px; } .ds-tabs { display: flex; width: max-content; border: 1px solid var(--accent-ink, #07090a); } .ds-tabs button { padding: 10px 18px; border: 0; background: none; color: var(--accent-ink, #07090a); font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.9063rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s; } .ds-tabs button + button { border-left: 1px solid var(--accent-ink, #07090a); } .ds-tabs button[aria-selected='true'] { background: var(--accent-ink, #07090a); color: var(--accent, #b8ff3c); } .ds-tabs button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-ink, #07090a); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-code { margin-top: 14px; background: var(--accent-ink, #07090a); color: var(--fg, #e8eee4); } .ds-code pre { margin: 0; padding: 20px; font-family: var(--font-mono, 'Geist Mono', monospace); font-size: 0.8125rem; line-height: 1.75; } .ds-code .p { color: var(--accent, #b8ff3c); }

narrative.overview:
The site is a dark sheet of ledger paper: green-tinted ink ground, bone text, 1px hairlines, square corners, pixel-grid display type. Everything is exact and unhurried. The hero proves the product by showing ASCII click-rain landing in a ledger whose SUM stays pinned at 0.00; the rest of the page is receipts, rows, and rules rather than cards and tiles.

One saturated field per page carries the brand color at scale: the install band, drenched in acid green with ink-black type. Elsewhere the accent is a sparse mark (a link, an icon, a focus ring, a node). Dark only; there is no light theme.

The UI kit (site/src/kit/) is shared by two sibling sites, Deskpost (amber) and LearnPuppy (pink). Each overrides only the --accent, --bg*, and --fg* custom properties in site/src/brand.css. This document records the bunfiiliate skin; the structure, type, hairlines, and components belong to the kit and must not be forked per brand.
keyCharacteristics: Pixel display type over a quiet humanist body; mono only for code, figures, and facts.
Square corners everywhere; separation by 1px hairlines and tonal steps, never shadows.
One drenched accent band; sparse accent marks elsewhere.
Receipt and ledger forms (dashed rows, dotted leaders, DR/CR, running sum) instead of icon-card grids.
Canvas is decoration only: aria-hidden, reduced-motion renders a still frame, all copy is real text.

rules.name: The One Field Rule
rules.body: Exactly one saturated acid-green field per page, the install band. Everything else uses the accent as a mark, never as a second block of color.

rules.name: The Skin Seam Rule
rules.body: A brand skin changes only --accent, --accent-ink, --bg*, --fg*. Never hardcode a hex in component CSS; read the token (the canvas reads tones from the computed custom properties).

rules.name: The Mono Is Literal Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono appears only for code, commands, figures, and facts; never for decorative headings or labels that are not data.

rules.name: The Pixel Is Display Rule
rules.body: The pixel face is used for headings, wordmark, and the faq "+" only, always weight 400 and letter-spacing 0; body text is never pixel.

rules.name: The Hairline Depth Rule
rules.body: Separate surfaces with a 1px line or a tonal step. No shadows, blur, or glass.

dos: Do keep every corner square and every divider a 1px hairline.
Do use Hugeicons through the kit icon set for all icons.
Do keep real numbers only (live stars, benchmarks) and hide a figure rather than invent it.
Do keep text in real DOM; the canvas is decorative and aria-hidden.
Do keep a 2px accent focus ring with 3px offset (ink on the acid band).
Do let sibling brands re-skin through brand.css tokens only.
donts: Don't add shadows, glass, gradients as decoration, or rounded corners; the only gradient is the hero legibility scrim.
Don't introduce a second saturated field or a light theme.
Don't build icon-card grids, hero metric tiles, fake logos, or invented customer counts.
Don't use Geist Mono or the pixel face for body copy.
Don't hardcode brand colors in kit CSS or JS.
